name: Breadcrumb
description:
The universal breadcrumb (R6.4): one line at --control-h-sm in the top bar. Every crumb
but the current one navigates; a crumb with siblings carries a switcher. It collapses
against its own width — first the middle crumbs, then to `‹ parent · current` — and each
crumb truncates with an ellipsis at a maximum width.
signature: ({ items, renderLink, collapse, header, scope, className, "aria-label": label }: BreadcrumbProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: collapse
props.description:
"auto" (default): measured, full → middle → compact → current. "current": always only the
current crumb with the trail in its popup (a host that has measured, as the top bar does
through BreadcrumbFoldContext).

props.name: header
props.description: First in the trail popup when the context is folded into it: the module switch.

props.name: items
props.description: Root first, current place last. Feed it from the router's matches.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Renders crumbs with `link` as router links (RouteBreadcrumb supplies this).

props.name: scope
props.description: The scope row above the trail when folded into it: the organisation.
